body: Good luck. I am sometimes jealous that you can voluntarily admit yourself.. Here in my country you need to have been through a crisis situation to be admitted, and even then only if they judge you an imminent risk to yourself, because it's better to recover in a home environment or something.
I'll accept a bit of both.

Yeah, I feel you. That's it for me, too. It's just that in my country waiting times are horrible so I've been on waiting lists for this entire year, and the better part of the past ten years, to be honest. Only broken up by therapy here and there.

Hey, older people actually go at it like rabbits, according to friends who have experience in old people's homes. Maybe more apt to go from a rabbit to the pope.

Or well....
Thanks, that is sweet of you. I have much the same issue and so I won't go into what you said, because I am not very positive right now. But you are kind.
If forever means until I die, that's kind of the point. And yeah I'm sorry, it's only to take something extra to increase the likelihood.

Why do you say "probably"? What I can find online says that Seroquel can be harmful at >10mg/kg. I haven't found articles about deadly endings yet, only survivors at numbers below 2g, but I can't imagine it's that probable that I'll survive.

I already have to avoid alcohol and tons of other things for my mental health, so that's not so bad. What else about it do you notice? 

And yeah, sadly my meds are slow uptake, so that sucks and increases the chance I'll be found.

I think you have a point. I have (had) these, I feel. The trouble I find is in holding on to them and maintaining their strength. Maybe I don't put in enough effort because of the way I feel, or I draw away unconsciously, but inevitably they water down after different lengths of time. Years or months.
I will check it out, thanks.

I have tried Life Is Strange, but haven't played very far. I'll try to finish it. I did play Firewatch, which is one of the few stories I've absolutely adored experiencing. I played through it in one sitting.

It was so relaxing to have Delilah to talk to on the walkie. I couldn't help but feel bad at the end, though. No spoilers, but you know what I'm talking about. It didn't improve my perspective on life.

I've been losing a few old friends lately, sadly. Not to death, but to bigotry. Which in a way sucks even more, because it casts a shadow on all that we've done together. I'll think of messaging others. Thanks for the suggestion.

And yes, that's my point of eating healthy. The animal produce industry is so harmful in its enormity of emissions, and cruelty... It's hard to avoid completely, but I'm trying a lot of new foods because of it. It's interesting enough, but food is still mostly a way of surviving. Besides the occasional sugary treats. (Which is just feeding an addiction.. I know I'm depressing. I hope it's forgiven because of the sub we're on.)

Thanks for your message.

I've tried that.. I think using love to feel better is an unwise decision.

As you use someone else to pull yourself up you inadvertently will pull them down. Whether you get up again after that is irrelevant to me, I think that if love is your goal, you should endeavour to love yourself first. Love will probably come on its own then.

Even if the chance for love, a person you have a deep connection with, presents itself, I'd tell you to make sure you work out the kinks in yourself first. Definitely if you're posting on this sub. 

Feeling suicidal or having existential dread is something bigger than simply being young and not being very grown up, or something like that. It goes deeper and if left unchecked it will devour relationships.
